subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should this branch continue as the maintainer-sponsored SQLite storage flip after removing the accidental event log and resolving conflicts, or should maintainers pause it in favor of a smaller replacement?
rationale: The branch changes persisted session/transcript storage, plugin SDK compatibility, workflows, and security-sensitive state; automation cannot choose the migration risk tolerance for existing users.

options.title: Clean and continue this flip
